DRINKS

Open bar, all night.

Imported and domestic beers, sparkling, white and red wine, spirits, mocktails and soft drinks. Bartenders on the floor through the event, plus a private bartender in the back room when you have it.

Food Packages

Three tiers, priced per person by how long you have the room:

  • Classic Social Welcome bites, display station, featured station, sweet finish$45 / 2hr · $65 / 3hr
  • Signature Smash Passed amuse, reception display, interactive station, dessert$55 / 2hr · $75 / 3hr
  • Luxe Celebration Elevated cocktail hour, two feature stations, dessert finale$65 / 2hr · $85 / 3hr

All menus include court time, unlimited fountain sodas, coffee, tea and water. Per person, plus tax and service.

Beverage Packages

Priced per person, per hour:

  • Courtside Beer, wine and soft drinks$8/pp per hour
  • Match Point With house spirits$11/pp per hour
  • Championship With premium spirits$14/pp per hour

Drink tickets or a consumption bar are also available. Packages vary by event.

Bundled into the per-guest rate rather than billed separately, so the number you agree is the number you pay.
